what: Reference sheets for tools/vehicles/fit, round 2 of br-bwju.12 (2026-10-18): a literal series-1 AU Falcon, generated with Muse Image (art/ui/frames/generate.mjs; every call in art/ui/frames/ledger.jsonl) as a chain, each step's prompt in prompts/round2/: 1 a calibration photograph of a real AU (Ford badges and plates in it; used only as the next step's reference, never committed); 2 that photo redrawn as a flat-shaded orange low-poly render with the base AU face (teardrop lamps, oval fish-mouth grille, one bar, a plain blank oval badge); 3 the turnaround in the Hawk Dash sheet's layout from that redraw (the r2a sheets); 4 the rear redrawn as the AU's (rounded corner lamps, plain oval on the boot; r2c); 5 the face widened and clarified (r2d, sheet 4 of 4 = lod-plus-1.png); 6 lowest-lod.png from lod-plus-1.png. Before modelling, crops of the sheets were shown to claude-haiku-5-5 with the recognition prompt (docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/recognition.md, 'Concept check'). Views are [x0, y0, x1, y1] windows on the 1920x1280 sheets. segment.dark 0.16 keeps the soft shadow under the car out of the masks; patch adds the side view's headlamp, which the grey backdrop swallows.
